SsdfFramework.description: One version of the SSDF as a whole: its practice groups, each holding its practices and their tasks.

practice_groups.description: The practice groups, in the order SP 800-218 gives them.

ssdf_version.description: The SSDF version, as NIST numbers it in the publication's title, such as 1.1.

SsdfFramework.title: SsdfFramework

SsdfImplementationExample.description: A notional implementation example: one type of tool, process or other method that could help implement a task.

description.description: What the practice group, practice, task or example says, in the words of whoever records it.

example_id.description: The example's identifier in NIST's reference data, such as PO.1.1.1 for the first example of task PO.1.1.

SsdfImplementationExample.title: SsdfImplementationExample

SsdfPractice.description: A secure software development practice: a named outcome with an identifier, a short explanation of what it is and why it helps, and the tasks that may be needed to achieve it.

description.description: What the practice group, practice, task or example says, in the words of whoever records it.

practice_id.description: The practice's identifier, such as PO.1.

practice_tasks.description: The tasks of the practice. A knowledge bundle relates a task to its practice with isPartOf instead.

title.description: The name SP 800-218 gives the practice group or practice.

SsdfPractice.title: SsdfPractice

SsdfPracticeGroup.description: One of the four groups SP 800-218 sorts its practices into: preparing the organization, protecting the software, producing well-secured software, and responding to vulnerabilities.

description.description: What the practice group, practice, task or example says, in the words of whoever records it.

group_id.description: The group's two letters, such as PO for Prepare the Organization.

group_practices.description: The practices of the group. A knowledge bundle relates a practice to its group with isPartOf instead.

title.description: The name SP 800-218 gives the practice group or practice.

SsdfPracticeGroup.title: SsdfPracticeGroup

SsdfReference.description: A pointer from a task to an established secure development document, and to the parts of that document the task maps to.

mapped_items.description: The parts of the document the task maps to, as SP 800-218 lists them, such as the clause, control or activity identifiers SM.3, DE.1.

reference_document.description: The document the task maps to, by the label SP 800-218 gives it.

SsdfReference.title: SsdfReference

SsdfReferenceDocument.description: The established secure development documents that SP 800-218 maps its tasks to, by the labels its References list gives them. SP 800-218 cites each at the edition shown in its title.
SsdfReferenceDocument.title: SsdfReferenceDocument

SsdfTask.description: An action that may be needed to perform a practice, with notional examples of how it could be implemented and references to the documents whose practices it maps to.

description.description: What the practice group, practice, task or example says, in the words of whoever records it.

former_task_ids.description: The identifiers the task had in an earlier SSDF version, which SP 800-218 notes beside the task after moving it, such as PW.3.1 for PO.1.3.

implementation_examples.description: Notional examples of tools, processes or other methods that could help implement the task. SP 800-218 requires none of them and does not claim they are the only ways.

task_id.description: The task's identifier, such as PO.1.1.

task_references.description: The established secure development documents the task maps to, each with the parts of the document it maps to.

SsdfTask.title: SsdfTask

description: One version of the SSDF as a whole: its practice groups, each holding its practices and their tasks.

practice_groups.description: The practice groups, in the order SP 800-218 gives them.

ssdf_version.description: The SSDF version, as NIST numbers it in the publication's title, such as 1.1.
